denominators.correctness: an SLO is met only when the operation's semantic answer stays complete: all RequiredCurrent features enabled, full diagnostics, full membership, no truncation

provenanceRules.promotion: a numeric budget becomes a measured SLO only through a WSP1 run against a recorded reference machine
provenanceRules.fabrication: a budget claiming measured provenance with no recorded machine manifest is invalid

rows.rationale: keystroke-to-paint stays inside one to two frames at every tier; the server budget is diagnostic evidence only
hover is a read; presentation must not wait for unrelated publication work
interactive authoring aid; partial lists are a completeness state, never a silent subset
diagnostics arrive complete per edit; dropping or truncating them to meet timing is forbidden
explicit save is a coarser interaction than typing but still interactive-tier, not batch
rename is an authored cross-file edit transaction; atomicity is not traded for timing

acceptance.ac1: every row carries a client-domain budget; a server-only measurement can never certify the row
acceptance.ac2: no row is met by reduced features, hidden truncation or reduced membership; denominators are part of the SLO
acceptance.acBasis: downstream runtime-test owner is WSP1 (registered in-train successor); PER0, WPF0 and JBT1 bind through their own charters
acceptance.acResource: equal-work corpus and limits live in the shared contract; unavailable metrics are labelled, never guessed
acceptance.acExposure: introduced operations: none; every row measures an existing product-surface operation family
